segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, so Acme Facilities is ready to renew, but they want the proposal by Friday because their finance cutoff is May 28.

segments.speaker: Chris
segments.text: Okay. Same package as this year or did they add anything?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: They’re moving from 38 to 42 seats, keeping the standard support tier, and they asked for a 12-month term instead of 24. Total comes to $31,080 before tax.

segments.speaker: Chris
segments.text: That should be inside the normal discount band, right?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yep, 8% discount, no special terms. The only slow part was getting the renewal built, because I had to enter the same seat count, dates, and discount in the CRM, the pricing sheet, the billing tool, and the contract portal, so that took most of yesterday afternoon and this morning.

segments.speaker: Chris
segments.text: Got it. Is the paper clean now?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah. Start date June 1, invoice net 30, procurement contact is Dana Reed. I’m sending the order form and the two-page proposal after this.

segments.speaker: Chris
segments.text: Cool. If they sign by Friday, can services still hold the June 10 go-live review?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: I checked with Sam. June 10 at 1 p.m. Eastern is fine, and they only need one admin on the customer side.

segments.speaker: Chris
segments.text: Perfect. Send it over, and cc me if Dana comes back on the term language.
